title: Fix black screen on open by moving auth/onboarding redirects into TanStack Router lifecycle

requirements.summary: Remove imperative navigation from AppContent render and ensure the app always renders a visible loading/auth UI while auth/profile state resolves.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the draft app no longer results in a black screen on first load.
frontend/src/App.tsx no longer calls router.navigate(...) during render (i.e., not inside conditional returns that return null).
When unauthenticated, the app renders a Login screen (or a loading screen while auth initializes) without rendering a blank page.
When authenticated but missing a user profile, the app routes to /onboarding without any render-loop/blank-screen behavior.
When authenticated and onboarding is complete, navigating to /onboarding redirects back to / without a blank screen.

file_operations.description: Refactor AppContent to remove all imperative navigation during render (remove router.navigate + return null branches). Always render either (a) a visible loading screen while Internet Identity and user profile are still resolving, or (b) RouterProvider once state is stable. Use the authorization component guidance for avoiding profile-setup flashes (actor-dependent loading state) where applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a reusable dark-theme loading screen component (EVRVEST-consistent) used during initial auth/profile resolution and as router pending UI; compose existing shadcn-ui primitives as needed (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui/*). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement auth/onboarding route guarding via TanStack Router route lifecycle (beforeLoad/loader redirects) instead of AppContent render logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Redirect decisions for auth/onboarding are executed via TanStack Router route lifecycle (not via direct router.navigate calls inside AppContent render).
Directly entering the following URLs behaves correctly without blank screens: /login, /onboarding, /, /exercises, /plans (subject to auth/onboarding state).

file_operations.description: Move auth/onboarding redirect rules into TanStack Router route lifecycle: add route-level guards (e.g., beforeLoad redirects) for (1) protected app routes under the layout to require authentication, (2) /onboarding to require authentication and redirect to / when profile exists, and (3) /login to redirect authenticated users to /onboarding when missing a profile or to / when onboarding complete. Provide router context derived from useInternetIdentity + useGetCallerUserProfile to enable guard decisions without using hooks inside beforeLoad. Configure router-level pending UI to use the new AppLoadingScreen. Use authorization component concepts for authenticated vs guest behavior and profile existence checks; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Remove/avoid component-level redirect logic (e.g., the useEffect navigate-to-/ when identity exists) so routing decisions are consistently handled by TanStack Router guards. Keep the login interaction intact via Internet Identity. Use authorization component login guidance (clearing cached data on logout is handled elsewhere) as a reference; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a dark-theme fallback UI for unexpected routing/auth errors with clear English text and a retry action to prevent empty screens.
acceptanceCriteria: If an unexpected error occurs during initial auth/profile/routing resolution, the user sees a readable error state (not a blank screen).
The fallback provides at minimum: a short error message in English and a way to retry (e.g., reload button) without requiring developer tools.

file_operations.description: Create an EVRVEST dark-theme error fallback UI component with clear English copy and a retry action (at minimum: reload button). Compose existing shadcn-ui components (read-only) for consistent styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the fallback so the app never renders an empty screen: configure TanStack Router default error handling to render RouteErrorFallback for unexpected router errors, and add an explicit guard in AppContent for unexpected auth/profile resolution failures (e.g., profile query error) to render RouteErrorFallback instead of returning nothing. Keep visuals consistent with the existing dark theme. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
